name: AWS Emulator
description: Emulates AWS APIs locally so developers and coding agents can test code against S3, DynamoDB and other services without an AWS account.

skills.name: Emulate AWS APIs
skills.description: Serves a local AWS API endpoint so the AWS CLI and SDKs create and read emulated resources without an AWS account.

skills.name: Test in CI
skills.description: Runs integration tests against emulated AWS services in CI pipelines, with no AWS account and no AWS resources.

skills.name: AWS-Matching Errors
skills.description: Returns the same validation errors as AWS, such as DynamoDB table-name length checks, so failing tests look real.

skills.name: Embedded Rust Mode
skills.description: Runs an isolated emulator in-process for each Rust test, wiring its HTTP client straight into the AWS SDK for Rust.

skills.name: Coding Agent Skill
skills.description: Installs an aws-emulator skill for Kiro, Cursor and Claude Code through the AWS CLI so agents set up the emulator.
